Baker, which between the late 1940s and the late 1950s specialised in turning out low-budget B-movies as unpublicised second-features for the UK cinema market. Scenes from the Academy Award-winning Frank Capra film "Mr. Smith Goes to Washington" are also used. What It Is to Burn (song) | "What It Is to Burn" is the title track off the album "What It Is to Burn" by the U.S. post-hardcore band Finch. How Far Shallow Takes You | How Far Shallow Takes You is the second full-length studio album by Gob, and was released on November 24, 1998, on Fearless Records. What the Brothers Sang | What the Brothers Sang is an album by Dawn McCarthy (of Faun Fables) and Bonnie 'Prince' Billy.  The album was released on February 19, 2013.
